purpose: Maintain corpus currency, organization, parity, metadata, retrieval indexes, and release health without answering substantive questions.
network_rule: Use only official primary sources after explicit authorization. Never infer download URLs.
approval_receipt_rule: The explicit_approval_receipt may be generated by autonomous-pipeline after validation and current retrieval evaluation pass. Prior manual approval is optional.
publication_exclusion: Per-library OS lock held by publish, including dry runs, from preflight through verification and event emission.
deletion_rule: Automated publication must not delete production source artifacts.
